# The AI Artisan Notes
> Rethinking Software Standards in the Age of AI — Field notes, architectural patterns, and engineering reflections by Mohamed Amine Bchir.

Author: Mohamed Amine Bchir (.NET Tech Lead & Software Craftsman)
Profile: https://tn.linkedin.com/in/mohamed-amine-bchir

## Core Principles & Philosophy
- The Three Shifts: Deprecated syntactic rituals, altered specification-driven architecture, and created evaluation harnesses for AI.
- Spec-Driven Engineering: Behavioral contracts are the persistent source of truth; implementations are disposable artifacts.
- Production Reality Over Demo Magic: High determinism, observability, and craftsmanship over brittle AI wrappers.

## Articles & Field Notes
- [What Our Tests Don't Prove](https://bchir.github.io/the-ai-artisan-notes/articles/what-our-tests-dont-prove.html): Unit, spec, and contract tests provide evidence for changes, but operational readiness still requires risk-based load and recovery checks.
- [Deterministic Quality Gates for AI Code](https://bchir.github.io/the-ai-artisan-notes/articles/deterministic-quality-gates-for-ai-code.html): Deterministic quality gates let agents fix routine violations before review, so people can focus on behavior, design, and engineering decisions.
- [Contract Tests for AI-Generated Service Integrations](https://bchir.github.io/the-ai-artisan-notes/articles/contract-and-integration-testing.html): Contract tests verify that services agree on APIs and message schemas, catching incompatible integrations and invented interfaces in AI-generated code.
- [Spec Tests at the Service Boundary](https://bchir.github.io/the-ai-artisan-notes/articles/testing-real-service-boundaries.html): Spec tests capture agreed service behavior in readable scenarios and run against the real application boundary, with examples and tooling across languages.
- [Unit Tests Are Dead. The Unit Moved.](https://bchir.github.io/the-ai-artisan-notes/articles/ai-unit-tests-unit-moved.html): AI can change implementation and its tests together. Learn how to shift code review toward agreed behavior and validate AI-assisted changes with separate checks.
